name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task commands getting to the goal square (the 'if you can' scopes the ability, not a preference), but the only Existence(at_goal) is soft, which forces nothing; the machine's FINAL_STATES (u1) is reached merely by has_key, so the task completes without ever reaching the goal. Add a hard Existence(at_goal); keep the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) and the hard Existence(has_key).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) hard plus Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard captures 'get to the goal after the key'; the chain forces has_key, making the separate Existence(has_key) redundant and removable, but a hard Existence next to the chain is optional and does not make the candidate wrong.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
